content.short: DeDust is a leading decentralized exchange and liquidity hub built on the TON blockchain.
content.description: DeDust is a premier automated market maker (AMM) and decentralized finance platform natively built on The Open Network (TON). It provides users with a high-speed and cost-effective environment for swapping digital assets, providing liquidity, and earning rewards through innovative farming programs. DeDust leverages TON's unique sharding architecture to ensure near-instant transaction finality and minimal slippage, even during periods of high network activity. The platform features an intuitive interface designed for both desktop and mobile users, making decentralized trading accessible to the massive Telegram ecosystem. As a critical piece of TON's infrastructure, DeDust drives liquidity and capital efficiency for the entire network.
content.meta: DeDust is the leading DEX and liquidity hub on the TON blockchain, offering high-speed swaps and yield-generating opportunities for the TON ecosystem.
